sources.title: AI-guided precision parenteral nutrition — Takeoff41
sources.snippet: One in ten neonates are admitted to neonatal intensive care units, yet the application of AI in guiding their care remains underexplored. Total parenteral nutrition is a life-saving treatment for preterm neonates, but implementing it in its current form is subjective, error-prone, and resource-consuming. sources.title: AI model formulates life-saving nutrition for NICU infants
sources.snippet: The scientists most recently developed TPN2.0, a new AI model that creates data-driven recipes of total parenteral nutrition (TPN), a life-saving treatment given to infants in the NICU.

sources.title: AI Model Can Optimize, Standardize Total Parenteral Nutrition Formulas
sources.snippet: By Elana Gotkine HealthDay Reporter TUESDAY, April 1, 2025 -- An artificial intelligence (AI) approach identified total parenteral nutrition (TPN) formulas that increase safety and potentially reduce costs for neonates admitted to neonatal intensive care units, according to a study published online March 25 in Nature Medicine.
